pr_body:
Refactor DatafeedContext from a POJO with a Builder to a Record.  This is mostly to reduce code footprint and improve readability in the `DatafeedContextProvider` class.  The lambda closures are now responsible for passing the fields to the DatafeedContext, rather than the Builder.

Close #107008

issue_context.title: [ML] Convert DatafeedContext to a record
issue_context.body:
### Description

From recent PR: https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/106948
It's possible to reduce code footprint of `DatafeedContext` by converting it into a record, removing the need to use volatile memory to pass objects between the listeners in `DatafeedContextProvider`.
